name: MassHire Franklin Hampshire Career Center
description: The public career center for Franklin County, Hampshire County and the North Quabbin area. It provides employment and training services at no charge to job seekers: job listings, job search resources, career exploration, career readiness workshops and seminars, education and training program information, and services for veterans, people with disabilities, DTA/SNAP recipients, mature workers and formerly incarcerated people. The main office is in Greenfield, with a job seeker access point at Forbes Library in Northampton on Wednesdays.
contact: (413) 774-4361; toll free 1-800-457-2603; info@masshirefhcareers.org; Greenfield Office, 101 Munson Street, Suite 210, Greenfield, MA 01301; Northampton Access Point at Forbes Library, 20 West Street, Northampton, MA 01060

requirements.text: Serves the 50 communities of Franklin and Hampshire Counties, plus Royalston, Athol, Phillipston and Petersham in Worcester County.
Provides employment and training services at no charge to job seekers and employers. Membership is easy and free.
Membership is required to register for Career Center services. The fastest way to become a member is to register yourself for MassHire JobQuest and get a Job Seeker ID.
To attend a Career Center Seminar, schedule it in JobQuest (My JobQuest, then Schedule CCS), in person or virtually, or call the front desk at (413) 774-4361 or 800-457-2603.

first_step.title: Become a free MassHire member
first_step.detail: Register yourself on MassHire JobQuest to get a Job Seeker ID, or call (413) 774-4361. On Wednesdays, job seeker services are at Forbes Library in Northampton, 10am-1pm.
